args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, 8 accepted.
Flagged (1): r03, summary_outlier. All three checks pass, but the largest flank difference is -11.7 %/h against a batch median of -8.1 %/h, about 44 % larger at the same 410 µm position. The centre REGR peak is also slightly low (52.77 vs 53.04 %/h). This makes r03's profile a different shape from the rest of the batch. r03 also kept a remedy: frames were registered on tissue from 400 px from the tip. That reference region may lie inside the ~695 µm growth zone, which would bias the flank strain rates.
Cleared (7): r01, r02, r04, r05, r06, r07, r08. All checks pass, and none kept a remedy or rolled back. Their non-zero z-scores come from a near-zero batch MAD. The real differences are small: flank-difference position 432 vs 410 µm, growth zone 674 vs 695 µm, and REGR peak within 0.05 %/h of the median.
What the flagged run shows: only one run was flagged, so there is no shared pattern. Its fault is a strain-rate profile of another shape, a flank difference unlike the batch, and it is the only run whose final measurement depends on a kept registration remedy.
